name: application-cta-banner-card
title: CTA Banner Card
description: A standalone gradient promotional card with a heading, supporting text, and one or two action buttons, for driving a specific conversion within page content rather than as a top-of-page bar.
useWhen: Promoting a specific upgrade, feature, or action within the body of a page (dashboard, settings, content feed), not as a global top-of-page notice.
The call to action benefits from strong visual weight (gradient background, large heading) to stand out from surrounding content.
avoidWhen: The message applies site-wide and needs a dismiss control at the top of every page — use announcement-banner for that placement and behavior instead.
The action is routine or low-stakes — reserve the high-visual-weight gradient treatment for genuinely promotional moments.
responsiveBehavior: The centered variant stacks its heading, message, and button row vertically and constrains message width (max-w-sm) so it reads well at any card width; the split variant's icon, text, and button stay in a single row down to moderately narrow widths before requiring a layout change.
accessibility: Heading uses a real <h2> so the card has a correct place in the page's document outline.
The icon accent in the split variant is decorative (aria-hidden); the heading and message independently convey the card's purpose.
Button labels are outcome-specific (Upgrade now, Publish) rather than generic, so their purpose is clear out of context to screen reader users navigating by button list.

variants.title: Centered gradient
variants.description: Centered card with a bold indigo-to-purple gradient, heading, message, and primary/secondary action buttons
accessibility: Uses a real <h2> for the promotional heading.
